system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you are equipped with only a single [One-Handed] or [Two-Handed] melee weapon. During the Cleanup Process of a round in which you have dealt damage with a [Melee Attack], you may reduce the total cleanup [Hate] cost of your [Harmony] skills by -[SR] (minimum 0). You gain a +[[POW Mod] x 2] bonus to your equipped [One-Handed] weapon.

A battle style that plays music on the battlefield while wielding weapons in the vanguard. Its appearance encourages allies and frightens enemies.
